name: Kofinas Amfissas Landing
notes:
There are (at least) two landings. One at the base of the hill (not for beginnners) and one across the main road in the big industrial area.

There are electricity cables and high voltage pylons around which are not dangerous as long as you notice where they are and keep them in mind.

name: Pefkoulia
notes:
Pefkoulia beach. Not too crowded. Shuttle service available. 7km from launch so find some lift along the way. Ridge above Pefkoulia beach is soarable with a 8+ mph west-ish wind.


Kathisma beach is closer. Not soarable but good bailout/sledder landing. Shuttle service is intermediately available to the upper launch from here.
